partners.mechanism_chain: DDOST (HGNC:2747) —DISRUPTS→ Protein folding and trafficking (GO:0006457); Protein folding and trafficking (GO:0006457) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); STT3A (HGNC:11008) —DISRUPTS→ N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Global developmental delay (HP:0001263); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebellar hypoplasia (HP:0001324); N-linked glycosylation (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital disorder of glycosylation (MONDO:0014270).
